policy: Free, key-less, documented public endpoints only. Every entry stays verified=false until a live GitHub Actions run has fetched and parsed it; then set verified=true with the run date. Values are current/revised data, not first-release vintages: do not use them for point-in-time backtests or surprise claims.

placeholders.{start_date}: ISO date lookback_days before the run date (FRED cosd)
placeholders.{boe_start}: Same start date as DD/Mon/YYYY for the BoE IADB Datefrom parameter
placeholders.{year}: Calendar year of the run date (Treasury CSV covers one year per request)

boe_iadb_query: csv.x=yes (CSV output); Datefrom=DD/Mon/YYYY; Dateto=now; SeriesCodes=<code>[,<code>]; CSVF=TN (tabular, no titles: header row DATE,<code>, dates like '02 Jan 2024'); UsingCodes=Y (series codes as column headers); VPD=Y (include provisional data); VFD=N (no data-flag columns)

Confirm the endpoint and fields at apidocs.hkma.gov.hk, add a parser with a fixture, then configure.
Not configured: MAS statistics APIs have moved behind an API gateway that issues keys; no documented key-less endpoint was found in the reference repo or reachable official docs.
